textLayer.readingTransliteration: [… auk : treke : auk : sihstin : þiʀ bo^þuþr : ristu : sta(i)… … : uifastr : kuþ : hialbi : au^nt : hans :]
textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: … ok Drængi ok Sigstæinn, þæiʀ brøðr ræistu stæi[n æftiʀ] Vifast. Guð hialpi and hans.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: … ok Drengi ok Sigsteinn, þeir brœðr reistu stei[n eptir] Véfast. Guð hjalpi ǫnd hans.
textLayer.translationSwedish: Sven lät resa denna sten efter sin broder Torsten…
textLayer.translationEnglish: Sveinn had this stone raised in memory of his brother Þorsteinn…
